subject: Control-plane & tenant isolation proof package — delivery and next steps
messages:

Subject: Step 2: isolation evidence for procurement

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — OakBank's platform security team reviewed the feature set and asked for a concise package that maps Redwood's control-plane isolation model to our audit requirements. Specifically they want:

- Network/zone diagram showing tenant control-plane segregation (full and degraded modes)
- Evidence of egress controls and KMS boundaries for private deployments
- Any SOC 2 / SIG pointers we can include in the RFP appendix

Can you produce something we can attach to our procurement queue by next week (target 2027-08-05)? If you can include a brief summary for our GRC lead (2-3 bullets) that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Audrey

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Step 2: isolation evidence for procurement

Hi Audrey —

Appreciate the clear list. We can deliver a compact evidence bundle that maps directly to your RFP asks. Plan and timeline:

1) By 2027-08-04: deliver a zipped evidence bundle (network diagrams, fencing matrix, SOC 2 pointer doc, and a one-page summary for GRC).
2) If you need an engineer call to walk through the diagrams we'll schedule a 45-min session the following week.

Quick summary for your GRC lead (draft):
- Control-plane isolation: dedicated control-plane namespaces per customer in private deployments; cross-tenant management plane segmented by role-based proxies and strict ACLs.
- Egress and KMS: customer VPC egress rules plus customer-managed KMS options; private deployments support HSM-backed key stores.
- Evidence: network topology diagrams, tenant fencing matrix showing allowed DNS/port flows, SOC 2 assertion summary, and an audit checklist for onboarding.

Kimberly — I cc'd you for SOC 2 and compliance pointers; Karthik please add any network-level callouts you want included. Audrey/Daniel — any additional items to include?

Best,
Sean

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Audrey Li <audrey.li@oakbank.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Step 2: isolation evidence for procurement

Adding technical detail for the bundle — high level callouts we'll include in the diagrams and matrix:

- Control-plane separation: primary control-plane instances run in a dedicated orchestration VPC per customer for Private deployments; Dedicated pools use tenant-aware orchestration with strict RBAC boundaries. The attached PDF (redwood_controlplane_isolation_diagram_v3.pdf) shows the four-layer segregation: edge gateway, tenant API proxy, model execution plane, and management plane.
- KV cache and prefix caching: per-tenant KV cache instances scoped to the execution plane; we document cache eviction policies and how we avoid cross-tenant leakage.
- Egress posture: default deny at the VPC egress ACLs; explicit egress only via managed NATs under a customer-defined whitelist. We'll include sample iptables/NSG entries in the CSV (tenant_fencing_matrix.csv).
- KMS: support for customer-managed keys via Cloud KMS + optional HSM integration; keys scoped per-account, with access audited and logged to immutable storage.

I've attached the network bundle (redwood_network_bundle_v2.zip) with layered diagrams and config snippets. Note: some snippets are redacted for internal opsec; we'll provide redacted config and a separate engineer-only session for live review.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Inference Infrastructure
redwood.ai

[attachment: redwood_network_bundle_v2.zip (archive)]
